Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities,

to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

DIMENSIONS FOR 
TV FERRITE COMPONENTS 

PART 6 BEAM CENTRING MAGNET FOR DEFLECTION COIL 

( First Revision ) 



( Reaffirmed 2004 ) 



1. Scope — This standard (Part 6) covers dimensions of beam centring magnet used in 
deflection coils suitable for black and white television picture tubes. 

2. Dimensions 

2.1 Dimensions of beam centring magnet, generally used in deflection coils suitable for black and 
white TV picture tubes of sizes 475 to 600 mm and having 28 mm neck diameter, are given in 
Fig. 1.

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard ( Part 6 ) was originally published in 1976. This revision has been undertaken 
to take into account the latest technological advancements and the current practices followed by 
the industry. While revising this standard, the dimensions of beam centring magnet for TV 
picture tube of size 300 mm have been modified.
